> A shared-mode fix so a migrated instance no longer bricks on `cwcli start`/`restart`.

### Upgrade Steps

* [ACTION REQUIRED] Anyone who enabled shared mode on v3.1.0 should update to v3.1.1. After updating, a plain `cwcli start` or `cwcli restart` self-heals any instance that was already affected - no other step is needed.

### Bug Fixes

* **Shared-mode setup now re-owns the bench workspace, not just the home directory, when it remaps the container user.** In shared mode, `cwcli start`/`restart` against a migrated instance used to leave the workspace owned by the pre-shared uid, so the remapped `frappe` user could no longer write `<bench>/logs/bench.log` and `bench start` crash-looped, taking the instance down. The re-own is keyed on a real ownership mismatch rather than on whether the uid changed this call, so it recovers an already-affected instance in place on the next `cwcli start`/`restart`.
